facts.fact: Jodi 来电告诉 Adam：她和 Emily 想试一个帮 Cole 的办法。
facts.anchor: “Me and Emily want to try something to help Cole,” Jodi said when she picked up.

facts.fact: Jodi 说这次尝试至少需要 three 个人，要 Adam 带上自己的 deck 去医院会合。
facts.anchor: “Yeah, but we need at least three people. So bring your deck and meet us at the hospital.”

facts.fact: Cole 仍像之前一样躺在病床上盯着天花板，有呼吸但很少眨眼。
facts.anchor: He lay there, like he had before, staring at the ceiling, breathing but rarely blinking.

facts.fact: 牌阵的终点牌抽到 The World 逆位——意味着他们没能定位 Cole，牌不知道他在哪里。
facts.anchor: The World. Reversed. That meant they didn’t have him, that the cards didn’t know where he was.

facts.fact: Adam 与 Jodi 齐声念出召唤词：『Cole Walker Lawrence，我们叫你回来，我们把你召唤到身边。』
facts.anchor: “Cole Walker Lawrence,” they said together. “We call you back. We summon you to us.”

facts.fact: 召唤中 Adam 听到了那首歌（the Between 之歌），立刻把双手从 Jodi 的手上抽开。
facts.anchor: Then he heard it—the song. Adam jerked his hands away from Jodi’s.

facts.fact: Adam 灵走（spirit walk）进入 the Between 却没看到 Cole，临结束时至少 a dozen 只 banshee（或许更多）朝他飞来。
facts.anchor: They flew toward him. At least a dozen banshees, maybe more.

facts.fact: Jodi 宣布结论：『这说明他们不在那儿』——Cole 和其他人并不在 the Between。
facts.anchor: “It means they aren’t there,” Jodi said. “Cole and the others aren’t in the Between.”
